notes: Feeds are read for headlines and summaries. Article pages are fetched only where robots.txt allows and the page is publicly accessible; paywalled sources contribute headline and summary only, and so does any page its publisher marks subscribers-only (schema.org isAccessibleForFree false; lib/extract.mjs subscribersOnly, 2026-10-25). Every published story links back to its sources. `owner`, `firstMention` and `mustSay` describe who speaks through an outlet: the writer names it the first time as `firstMention` gives it, and the checks send back a story whose first mention of it drops every `mustSay` word (lib/outlets.mjs; the owner, 2026-10-25: the Turkish, Iranian and Indian press joined "with ownership labels").

papersNotes: Open-access economics research read only by the paper mode (--mode=paper); the news editor never sees these. Verified 2026-09-12. `abstractOnly` marks series whose landing page yields no more than the abstract (the feed carries it; `summaryChars` keeps it whole); `allowPdf` admits a series whose feed links straight to the PDF. Dropped after testing: IMF (HTTP 403 to every client), BIS (the doclist RSS is gone from the redesigned site), CEPR VoxEU (feed fine, column pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge), AEA JEP, IZA (no RSS) and OECD (HTTP 403).
